answer: The cipher receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a nadir seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, so that the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. Each copy needs 3 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
